executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile Event-Space Totals and Room Counts
executiveSummary.lead: Charlotte Marriott City Center ranks second in its certified six-hotel set, but appears in only 38.6% of eligible scenarios and 12.5% of comparable consideration answers. Official pages verify an Uptown location, convention-center connection, five restaurants, M Club, and substantial meeting capacity. The priority is to reconcile competing event-space totals and organize those verified strengths into consistent buyer context.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared. Certified Peer Position uses only the named certified Marriott Bonvoy set. These measures do not represent bookings, ADR, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Reconcile Event-Space Totals and Room Counts
themes.what: The events page reports 10 event rooms, 23,011 square feet, 13 breakout rooms, and capacity of 1,450; the overview and meeting narrative state 20,000 square feet and 13 breakout areas.
themes.whyItMatters: Planners need one setup-qualified inventory; rounding may be valid, but the counting and area basis should be explicit.

themes.title: Strengthen Uptown and Convention-Center Decision Context
themes.what: Official content places the hotel at 100 West Trade Street, describes a connection to Charlotte Convention Center, and names Spectrum Center and Bank of America Stadium; ADP recorded 0% recognition for Uptown, convention-center proximity, and walkable downtown.
themes.whyItMatters: These are verified location assets that can be made consistent without claiming they caused the measured visibility gap.

themes.title: Organize Dining and M Club Facts Across Priority Pages
themes.what: Marriott lists five restaurants, Stoke Charlotte, Stoke Bar, Coco and the Director, in-room dining, and M Club; ADP recorded 0% restaurant and in-room dining recognition, with M Club at 20%.
themes.whyItMatters: Complete and consistent outlet, meal-period, and lounge facts can improve buyer context, although no booking or ranking outcome is promised.
